WPT|/pf.adv.cards/3/3: {SG2}, {SG3}, {SG3T} and {SG3F} bond to matt damp concrete, block vapour (sd > 100 m) and negative water pressure up to 3 bar; {SG2} blocks capillary-rising oil after the cleaning with {R008} — radon tight by test.
WPT|/pf.adv.cards/4/2: Fast where the schedule is tight
WPT|/pf.adv.cards/4/3: {SG3F} is overcoated after approx. 3.5 hours; {V360} is walkable after 16 hours — the garage floor in two days; {EV200} reaches approx. 65 N/mm² after 24 hours and carries the machine the next day.
WPT|/pf.adv.cards/5/3: Slip resistance set with quartz sand or {ANTI} (R10 to R12 by test reports), standard RAL colours for {B351} and {V360}, the glossy UV-stable {V2260} on top; seamless surfaces that are cleaned with {R008}.
WPT|/pf.pictos/0/2: two-component epoxy and polyurethane resins that cure by chemical reaction — solvent-free, in layers from 0.1 to 2 mm, up to 200 mm as a mortar
WPT|/pf.pictos/1/2: CE after EN 1504-2 (surface protection), EN 13813 (screed material), EN 1504-4 (structural bonding), EN 1504-6 (anchoring), EN 15651-4 (joint sealants); EPD; EMICODE; slip resistance by test report
WPT|/pf.pictos/2/2: sealed pores: water, oil and chemicals are wiped off instead of drawn in — hygienic surfaces, suitable for indirect food contact ({B351}), maintained with {R008}
WPT|/pf.adv.lists/0/1/0: floor coatings on cement-based substrates, interior and exterior ({B351})
WPT|/pf.adv.lists/0/1/1: garages, cellars, auxiliary rooms, warehouses: the aqueous seal {V360}
WPT|/pf.adv.lists/0/1/2: workshops, production and storage halls, logistics: {GBM} + {B351}
WPT|/pf.adv.lists/0/1/3: matt damp, young or vapour-loaded concrete: {SG3}, {SG3T}, {SG3F}
WPT|/pf.adv.lists/0/1/5: sewage treatment plants, sewage pipes, digestion towers, steel sheet piles: {V2370}
WPT|/pf.adv.lists/0/1/6: machine bases, crane rails, anchors, breakouts: {EV200}, {K4031}
WPT|/pf.adv.lists/1/1/0: pigmented, self-levelling, fillable with quartz sand — {B351}
WPT|/pf.adv.lists/1/1/1: watertight against negative pressing water up to 3 bar — {SG2}, {SG3}, {SG3T}, {SG3F}
WPT|/pf.adv.lists/1/1/2: diffusion-inhibiting, methane and radon barrier tested — {SG3}, {SG2}
WPT|/pf.adv.lists/1/1/5: sulphuric acid pH 0–1, XWW4, stray-current insulating — {V2370}
WPT|/pf.adv.lists/2/1/0: one supplier for every layer, matched to each other
WPT|/pf.adv.lists/2/1/1: seamless, hygienic surfaces that are easy to clean
WPT|/pf.adv.lists/2/1/2: slip resistance adjustable from R10 to R12
WPT|/pf.adv.lists/2/1/3: standard RAL colours and transparent seals
WPT|/pf.adv.lists/2/1/4: a primer for every substrate — no waiting for the concrete to dry
WPT|/pf.adv.lists/2/1/5: walkable after 12–16 hours, full load after 7 days
WPT|/pf.adv.lists/2/1/6: EPD and EMICODE for the environmental and emission requirements of the project

WPT|/pf.tl.title: From the substrate to the finished floor, step by step

WPT|/pf.m3d.label: 3D Model
WPT|/pf.m3d.title: Inspect the floor in 3D
WPT|/pf.m3d.sub: The floor as it is built: the prepared slab, the primer with its sand, the levelling and the repairs, the coating, the finish with the seal and the joints, the floor in service — and, in the exploded view, every layer lifted apart. Go through the stages, drag to rotate, zoom in on the details.
WPT|/pf.m3d.caps/0: The substrate shot-blasted, the edges ground with dust extraction, the residual moisture (CM) and the dew point checked, repairs made, vacuumed dust-free
WPT|/pf.m3d.caps/1: The primer rolled into the pores, quartz sand broadcast onto the fresh coat
WPT|/pf.m3d.caps/2: The scratch coat poured in ribbons, drawn tight with the flat blade and sanded while fresh; the machine base grouted with {EV200}
WPT|/pf.m3d.caps/3: The coating poured in ribbons, spread to gauge with the pin rake in spiked shoes and de-aerated criss-cross with the spiked roller
WPT|/pf.m3d.caps/4: The interspersing coat broadcast with quartz sand to excess, the loose sand vacuumed off, the top seal rolled criss-cross; the joints re-cut, backed and filled with {IPU}
WPT|/pf.m3d.caps/5: In service: forklifts, spills and cleaning — the floor stays closed
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfgarage/prime: The aqueous {V360} diluted with 8–10 % water, rolled criss-cross as the primer
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfgarage/level: Pinholes filled with {V360} + {FF}, unevenness levelled with {V360} + quartz sand, sanded and vacuumed when hard
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfgarage/coat: The first coat of the {V360} seal, rolled criss-cross
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfgarage/finish: The second coat with {ANTI}: R10, the joint re-cut and filled with {IPU}
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfgarage/service: In service: the car driven in and the motorcycle ridden in — the tyre marks from outside and the oil drip wiped off the satin floor; the motorcycle on its side stand with the pad and the drip tray under it, the trolley jack by the wall
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfdamp/prep: The young, matt damp slab shot-blasted and the edges ground; the CM test finds the moisture that calls for the barrier primer; the ground water presses from below
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfdamp/level: The scratch coat poured in ribbons, drawn tight with the flat blade and sanded while fresh
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfdamp/prime: The barrier primer {SG3} in two coats blocks the vapour; sand on the second
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfdamp/service: In service: the vapour pressure from below blocked, the floor dry and clean
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfoil/prep: Shot-blasted and the edges ground; the oil-soaked areas scrubbed with {R008} and hot water and picked up wet — not dried off
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfoil/level: The machine base grouted with the flowable {EV200}, poured from the pail into the formwork
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfoil/prime: The oil barrier primer {SG2} on the still damp concrete, quartz sand over the whole surface
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfoil/service: In service: the workshop floor closed against oil from above and from below
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfsewage/prep: The tank floor and walls blasted, the edges ground with extraction, the moisture checked; steel parts blasted to Sa 2½
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfsewage/prime: The thixotropic barrier primer {SG3T}: the walls rolled first in vertical strokes on extension poles, then the floor
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfsewage/level: Breakouts and the gully grouted with the flowable {EV200}, poured from the pail
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfsewage/coat: The first layer of {V2370}: walls first, rolled top to bottom, then the floor and the steel
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfsewage/finish: The second layer of {V2370} in the alternating colour; the joints re-cut and filled with {IPU}
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfsewage/service: In service: sewage, sulphuric acid pH 0–1, sea water — the coating holds
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfhall/prep: The slab shot-blasted, the edges ground with dust extraction, the residual moisture (CM) and the dew point checked, vacuumed dust-free
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfwork/level: The scratch coat poured in ribbons, drawn tight with the flat blade and sanded while fresh
WPT|/pf.m3d.capsOv/pfwork/finish: The glossy PU top seal {V2260} with {ANTI} on the coating; the joints re-cut and filled with {IPU}
WPT|/pf.m3d.fallback: The 3D view needs WebGL and an internet connection to load. The cross-sections in the section “System” show the same sequence.
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfgarage/0/1: The aqueous {V360} is primer, levelling compound and seal in one product: diluted as the primer, filled with quartz sand or {FF} for the levelling, rolled in two steps as the seal — walkable after 16 hours, the garage done in two days.
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfgarage/1/1: The seal resists the softeners of car tyres, dilute acids and alkalis, heating oil and petrol; it is pigmented in standard RAL colours and vapour permeable, so the slab can still breathe.
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfgarage/2/1: With 8–10 % {ANTI} in the last coat the floor reaches slip class R10; the wall–floor joint is closed with {IPU}, elastic and UV-resistant.
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfwork/0/1: {GBM} seals the pores and, sanded, keys the coating; {B351} at approx. 1 mm is the pigmented self-levelling floor of the workshop and the commercial unit: approx. 70 N/mm², Shore D approx. 72, resistant to oils, acids and cleaning agents.
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfwork/1/1: {V2260}, the aqueous PU seal, makes the coating light-fast, UV-stable and scratch resistant and gives it the gloss of a showroom; with {ANTI} it is slip resistant.
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfwork/2/1: Breakouts and anchor holes are filled with {K4031}; the field and connection joints are cut, primed and filled with {IPU} — chamfered 45° where vehicles cross.
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfhall/0/0: Two coats of primer, sand in between
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfhall/0/1: High loads need a pore-sealed, well-keyed substrate: {GBM} in two steps, the second broadcast with quartz sand Ø 0.1–0.6 mm; a scratch coat of {GBM} + sand where the slab is rough.
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfhall/1/1: {B351} filled 2 : 1 with quartz sand, spread at approx. 2 mm and de-aerated: the forklift, the pallet truck and the dropped pallet meet approx. 70 N/mm² and 44 N/mm² flexural; the machine bases are grouted with {EV200} (approx. 109 N/mm²).
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfhall/2/1: The slip-resistant finish — interspersing coat, quartz sand Ø 0.5–1.0 mm broadcast, top seal — reaches R11 by test report and up to R12; the joints are filled with {IPU}, 25 % total deformation.
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfdamp/0/0: The concrete need not be dry
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfdamp/0/1: A young slab, a basement floor on ground water, a floor without a vapour barrier: {SG3} bonds to the matt damp concrete, blocks vapour and negative pressing water up to 3 bar and seals the pores — two coats, the second sanded.
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfdamp/1/1: {SG3F} does the same in a fraction of the time: the second coat after approx. 3.5 hours, the coating within 5 days; it also makes the repair mortar that carries load again quickly.
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfdamp/2/1: {SG3T}, the thixotropic version, goes up the plinth and the wall and makes the capillary-breaking mortar; above it the floor is coated with {B351} like any dry floor.
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfoil/0/1: Oil that has risen through the concrete cannot be coated over: the surface is shot-blasted, then cleaned with {R008} and hot water, scrubbed twice and vacuumed — and not dried off, because the primer must meet the damp, oil-free surface.
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfoil/1/1: {SG2} displaces the water from the capillaries and blocks capillary-rising oil and vapour (sd > 100 m) and water pressure up to 3 bar; quartz sand Ø 0.5–1.0 mm over the whole fresh surface gives the key.
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfoil/2/1: On the sanded barrier the thick coat of {B351} with quartz sand, the slip-resistant finish and the joints with {IPU} follow as in any hall; breakouts and machine bases with {EV200}.
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfsewage/0/1: Sewage, sulphuric acid down to pH 0–1, sea water, the abrasion of the flow: {V2370} is the sealing coating for sewage treatment plants, sewage pipes, digestion towers and steel sheet piles — exposure class XWW4 after DIN 19753.
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfsewage/1/0: Primer on concrete, none on steel
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfsewage/1/1: On the cementitious substrate the thixotropic barrier primer {SG3T} goes first, on floor and walls; on steel blasted to Sa 2½ the first layer of {V2370} is the primer. Two layers in alternating colours show the coverage.
WPT|/pf.m3d.co/pfsewage/2/1: Breakouts, gullies and anchors are grouted with {EV200} — watertight to 5 bar from 10 mm; the movement joints are filled with {IPU}, −40 to +80 °C.
